BUG FOUND: after successful /auth/register via AuthModal, modal closes but the app does NOT navigate to /client (user is logged in — BT avatar visible — but URL stays at '/'). Root cause: AuthModal.handleRegister calls handleClose(false) synchronously after register() resolves; because React batches setUser + setAuthOpen(false), the redirect useEffect's guard `if (authOpen && user && user.id)` sees authOpen=false and returns without navigating.

Recommend: after `await register(...)`, if not `bd_suppress_auth_redirect`, do `navigate('/client')` explicitly, then setAuthOpen(false). Otherwise keep suppression path intact.

critical_code_review_comments: HIGH — AuthModal.jsx L154-162: handleRegister awaits register() then unconditionally calls handleClose(false). This bypasses the L62-81 useEffect redirect because authOpen becomes false in the same React batch as user being set, so the effect's `if (authOpen && user && user.id)` guard fails on the next commit. Login flow works because handleLogin does NOT call handleClose — it lets the effect close+redirect. Either (a) do the same for register: after register() just let the effect run (remove handleClose), or (b) explicitly navigate('/client') in handleRegister before closing.

MEDIUM — RequirementForm step-3 Serviceability Check uses a modal 'Change' address picker (req-change-location) with no direct req-location-<id> test-ids on the list items; makes E2E covering Flow A/D/F fragile from headless tests. Add data-testid=req-location-option-<slug> on each option row inside the picker to unblock automation.

rca of the issue: AuthModal.jsx registration redirect bug: The redirect useEffect (L62-81) is guarded by `if (authOpen && user && user.id)`. handleRegister (L139-162) awaits register() (which sets user in AuthContext) and then immediately calls handleClose(false) which sets authOpen=false. React 18 batches both state updates in the same commit; on next render authOpen is already false, so the effect early-returns without calling navigate('/client'). Login works because handleLogin does NOT call handleClose — the effect fires first with authOpen=true, closes the modal, and navigates. FIX: mirror the login pattern for register — remove `handleClose(false)` from handleRegister and let the effect handle the redirect + close, OR call navigate('/client') explicitly in handleRegister before closing.
